title: Glassy Fluids
description: Makes liquids transparent like glass + Minor tweaks
body:
Ever wanted a resource pack to make liquids _transparent_? So you could _visibly see_ valuable ores or ruins underneath? Or increase your game _performance_? Well, look no further and check out **Glassy Fluids**!

**Glassy Fluids** makes lava and water see-through from above. It also renders nether portal blocks transparent and fires (normal and soul variants) invisible.

To improve game experience, please:
1. Set render distance to at least 12 blocks.
2. Set particles to minimum. (This eliminates the amount of smoke particles emitted from fire blocks)

### Note: This resource pack may not receive any updates unless required
